title: ContractObituarie
tagline: Analyzing smart contracts using contracts obituaries using 0G AI and a cool UI
description: Contract Obituaries is a dApp that uses 0G AI to identify and publish reports on dead, exploited, or deprecated smart contracts. Users can submit contract addresses with reasons like hacks or deprecation. The app flags risks and suggests alternatives—helping prevent fund loss and making smart contract interactions safer across Web3.
how_its_made: ontract Obituaries is a dApp that flags dead, exploited, or deprecated smart contracts using 0G AI. Users can submit contract addresses along with context like hack reports or tweets. 0G AI analyzes the contract and returns a risk label (e.g., Exploited, Deprecated), along with safer alternatives. The app helps prevent accidental interaction with risky contracts by surfacing warnings in a clean, searchable interface. Built with Next.js and 0G AI, the project simplifies smart contract safety without needing a custom indexer or on-chain graph. It’s a lightweight, developer-friendly way to improve Web3 transparency, security, and user awareness in DeFi and beyond. Used Meta wallet to connect.
